subject.title: [Bug]: OpenClaw Tool Lifecycle / Gateway Recovery Field Report

question: Should post-tool continuation failures preserve a resumable agent session state, or should OpenClaw continue to fail closed and only add durable tool receipts for operator diagnosis?
rationale: Current code intentionally treats replay-unsafe incomplete turns as abandoned; changing that affects side-effect safety, retries, transcript state, and user recovery semantics.

options.title: Define Session-Survival Contract
options.body: Specify when a post-tool failure remains resumable and implement recovery only for those proven-safe states.

options.title: Add Receipt-Only Diagnostics
options.body: Persist richer tool lifecycle receipts while leaving retry and resume behavior fail-closed for now.

options.title: Defer To Narrow Replay Issues
options.body: Keep this broad recovery issue open only as context while fixing narrower replay-unsafe and provider-error reports separately.

recommendation.title: Define Session-Survival Contract
recommendation.body: Specify when a post-tool failure remains resumable and implement recovery only for those proven-safe states.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows steipete carrying terminal classifier, agent-loop, and current-attempt recovery changes across the relevant files.
